prompt: In the bag, pressing + on an item that is nearly sold out shows "Only 2 left", but the quantity stays at 3 and the subtotal includes the third item until I reload. Checkout then charges for 2. Make the bag show what the server actually accepted.

truth.cause: changeQuantity commits the requested change into the base lines state after updateLineQuantity resolves, even when the server rejected it, so useOptimistic has nothing to roll back to.
truth.summary: After the action resolves, replace the base state with the cart the server returned (result.cart.lines) instead of re-applying the requested change.
